name: The Number 10
overview: The number 10 appears in Scripture in contexts that emphasize God's communication and authority, as seen in the LORD speaking to Moses in Numbers 9:1 and 10:1. It also symbolizes completeness and judgment, illustrated by the ten horns and crowns on the beast in Revelation 13:1. These passages reveal God's sovereign control over His people and the unfolding of His divine plans.
